replacement_semantics: Apply after Amendment 001. Replace only the listed still-effective base units; preserve all other effective units.

units.content: Defines aligned information velocity Λ_E, information gain I(H;O), and utility alignment A(U|O,Cfrak).
Source states experiments may be valuable by eliminating possibility regions and characterizes high-information/low-alignment cases as benchmark gaming, irrelevant optimization or artifact discovery.
Defines χ:(g,n,U)->(g',n',U'), metric transformation χ_g, dimensional transformation χ_n, and structural detection criterion using description-length reduction and accessibility.
Source claims a genuine breakthrough compresses complexity previously carried by the human operator or external process.
Case focuses on manual gradient specification -> automated derivative generation, explicitly distinguishing autodiff from backpropagation and from a generic non-learning -> deep-learning transition.
Hypothesizes automatic differentiation transformed search by transferring derivative-computation complexity from explicit human reasoning into computational substrate.
Source answers partially yes to capability growth without clear prior Λ_E and partially yes to resource-dominant explanations in mature regimes.
Classifies mixed/weak falsification pressure, says CPB is strongest for geometry-changing abstractions and weaker for mature optimization regimes, and says framework survives with refinement.
Document explicitly does not attempt to resolve subjective experience directly and frames itself as a computational exploration.

Hypothesizes consciousness emerges when specialized information-processing mechanisms become a unified self-integrating search process with integration, self-modeling, coordination and search-strategy modification.

Names IICG and CPB, states IICG studies representations reshaping computational geometry while CPB studies when geometric changes produce capability transitions, and calls playlist taxonomy a phenomenological analogue. IICG endpoint remains unresolved at map level.
Proposes testing whether asking how something transforms future exploration consistently improves classification or decisions in domains for which CPB was not designed.
